title: elaphoglossum dimorphum
intro: Elaphoglossum dimorphum, commonly known as the "Dimorphic Elaphoglossum", is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its unique characteristics and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes.
